justification: Developer-tooling change: the local pre-push hook skips checks that CI's gates workflow runs again; no product code, no data.

break_it.scenario: A failing test is pushed because the local suite no longer runs.
break_it.what_happens: CI's gates run fails on the PR and check_pr_gates.py refuses the merge, so nothing reaches main.
break_it.how: Every skipped stage also runs in .github/workflows/gates.yml, and the merge gate requires that run to pass. PREPUSH_FULL=1 restores the local run.

post_merge.manual_verify: Next push prints the 'left to CI' line.
